about: The three modes, cycled with settings.hotkey_mode. How many points each style event gives in each mode is in style_events (points_<mode id>).

id.desc: Row id; style_events has a points_<id> column for it

summary.desc: One line shown for 3 s when switching to it

suppress_ron_penalties.desc: Turn off Ready or Not's unauthorized-force penalties (hooks.penalty_suppress)

switch_sound.desc: Clip played when switching to this mode

rows.label: CLEAN
rows.summary: Arrests, takedowns and fast clears. Unauthorized force drops you to D.

rows.label: ULTRAKILL RULES
rows.summary: Kills, headshots and multi-kills feed the meter. Best rank is your score.

rows.label: POWER
rows.summary: Everything earns style. Rank makes you faster. ULTRAKILL rank shrugs off a hit.
